title: ARPAPED Capability Manifest
description: Machine-readable declaration of a capability contract and the executor references that implement it. Lives with the capability's generic footprint (R3/R4), one entry per implementation. Consumed by the generic assembler during the Publish phase (Phase 8) to build and register implementation records into the canonical Registry.

capability_id.description: Generic capability identity per R1 as domain.operation. Never product-prefixed.

contract.description: Path or identity of the contract artifact that machine-defines this capability (R2).

contract_version.description: Version of the capability contract this manifest binds to.

implementation_id.description: Unique identifier of this implementation record.

executor.description: Reference to the registration-unaware executor as 'module:attr'. The component is reached only by the Bridge; it never registers itself.
